name: Bridge Ratings
description:
This dataset contains inspection and condition records for bridges, likely in New York City given the borough codes and coordinates. Each row represents a bridge, identified by a BIN (Bridge Identification Number), with details on what the bridge carries (such as a road or pedestrian path) and what it crosses (such as a river, parkway, or railroad). The data includes bridge type, number of spans, ownership and rating source, the date of the most recent inspection, and condition measures: a numeric current rating, a verbal rating (Good, Fair, Very Good, Poor, or Closed), and a general recommendation score. Physical and financial attributes include deck area in square feet and estimated replacement cost. Location fields cover borough, latitude and longitude (available for about half the records), and community district codes.

The dataset supports bridge infrastructure analysis and asset management. It can be used to map bridge conditions by borough or district, compare ratings across bridge types and owners, identify structures in poor condition or closed, estimate
